title: www.tannerclinic.com
description: Tanner Clinic is a physician-owned healthcare provider in Utah, offering a wide range of urgent care and medical services including family medicine, pediatrics, dermatology, and behavioral health. They focus on patient-centered care, providing accessible and compassionate treatment for both minor injuries and chronic conditions. With multiple locations and extended hours, Tanner Clinic aims to deliver quick, reliable healthcare solutions tailored to the needs of families in the community. Their innovative approach includes telehealth options, ensuring that patients can receive care conveniently and efficiently.
